top_comments.author: @mattchouinard5321
top_comments.text:
You very rarely want an LLM to act on its default settings.

a good basic prompt structure is:

outcome (sales team hits 20% conversion rate within 6 months)

persona/role (an expert sales coach and strategest who isnt afraid to give corrective feedback)

task: (help the user brainstorm and develop a 5 point plan for the sales team of the user's buissness to effectively scale up sales conversion)

context (examine the attached files-buisness dna, s.o.p.s, sales employee profiles, prior sales data. collect any additional context required via reverse interview)

constraints (final document must not exceed 300 words. Avoid filler and irrelevant info.)

output/format (a professionally formatted pdf designed for ease of sharing. Keep document appearance congruent with the business DNA)
